facts.text: Maison Delano Paris is located in the heart of the 8th Arrondissement.
facts.excerpt: Located in the heart of the 8th Arrondissement, Maison Delano Paris is a luxury hotel

facts.text: The hotel has a Parisian courtyard of an 18th century mansion.
facts.excerpt: The quintessential Parisian courtyard of an 18th century mansion is just one of three incredible settings to host your next gathering.

facts.text: The hotel tempers aristocratic grandeur with modernity.
facts.excerpt: Guests are welcomed to an irresistible environment that tempers aristocratic grandeur with modernity

facts.text: The Presidential Suite features original marble fireplaces, painted ceilings and intricate mouldings.
facts.excerpt: Original marble fireplaces, painted ceilings and intricate mouldings take center stage in the Presidential Suite

facts.text: Rooms are appointed with modern furnishings in a neutral palette layered with olive green hues, ethereal curtains and contemporary artwork.
facts.excerpt: rooms are appointed with modern furnishings rendered in an understated neutral palette, and layered with rich olive green hues, ethereal curtains, and contemporary artwork

facts.text: The Grand Prestige Suite has restored painted ceilings and original 18th-century mouldings.
facts.excerpt: The exceptional Grand Prestige Suite reflects the rich history of the building through its beautifully restored painted ceilings, soaring proportions and original 18th-century mouldings.

facts.text: The Grand Prestige Suite has a second-floor balcony with views over the Faubourg Saint-Honoré.
facts.excerpt: step onto the second-floor balcony and enjoy views over the prestigious Faubourg Saint-Honoré

facts.text: The Grand Historic Suite has herringbone parquet flooring, original painted ceilings, marble fireplaces and a balcony overlooking the Faubourg Saint-Honoré.
facts.excerpt: through its herringbone parquet flooring, original painted ceilings, marble fireplaces and a sweeping balcony overlooking the Faubourg Saint-Honoré

facts.text: The Grand Prestige Suite can be connected to the Grand Historic Suite to create a two-bedroom suite.
facts.excerpt: The Grand Prestige Suite can be connected to the neighbouring Grand Historic Suite to create an expansive two-bedroom suite.

facts.text: The Presidential Suite combines the two largest suites at the hotel and has soaring frescoed ceilings.
facts.excerpt: Combining the two largest suites at Maison Delano Paris, the Presidential Suite is distinguished by magnificent herringbone parquet flooring, remarkable 18th-century architectural features, soaring frescoed ceilings

facts.text: The Deluxe Suite has a separate living room and overlooks the hotel's inner courtyard.
facts.excerpt: Designed as a refined Parisian apartment, the Deluxe Suite features a separate living room

facts.text: Prestige Rooms overlook either the city streets or the hotel's historic courtyard.
facts.excerpt: Overlooking either the streets of the City of Light or the hotel’s historic courtyard

facts.text: Rooms have MALIN+GOETZ bath amenities and Tessicasa linen bedding.
facts.excerpt:
MALIN+GOETZ bath and shower amenities
- Tessicasa linen & cotton bedding

facts.text: Delano Café is a French-Mediterranean restaurant in the historic hotel courtyard.
facts.excerpt: Delano Café – vibrant French-Mediterranean dining in the historic hotel courtyard
Delano Bar, a sophisticated setting for innovative cocktails

facts.text: The concierge can arrange in-room massages, a hair stylist on demand and airport transfers.
facts.excerpt: From airport transfers and museum tickets to in-room massages, a hair stylist on demand, our paid parking facilities, and even accommodating your pets (additional fees apply).
